notes: Modified cash basis audit, FY ended 9/30/2022. Governmental lines from the governmental funds Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances Totals 2022 column (p6; labels p5). Taxes 305,117 split by Schedule 2 totals (p11: property 147,001, motor vehicle 9,217, sales 148,899; non-major funds have no taxes); Intergovernmental 93,971 split by Schedule 2 totals (p11). Charges for services 83,909 split into General Fund garbage collection 78,164 (Schedule 2 p10) and non-major charges 5,745. Bond proceeds 545,000 recorded as debt_proceeds; bond principal and interest printed under Other financing sources (uses) recorded as other_financing. Business-type statement lines from the government-wide Statement of Activities (p2; Water expenses 109,343 include interest expense 2,069; Water capital grants 10,000 = Exhibit H Grant proceeds); business_type is net position (modified cash), ties 875,196 + 139,298 - 143,648 + 54,041 = 924,887. Proprietary cash flows from Exhibit I (p9). Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1) because it includes capital assets and debt; zero line 'Restricted for public works' omitted. Beginning cash = governmental funds Totals 2021 total assets (p4). Detail: Schedule 2 major funds (pp10-11), Schedule 4 non-major funds one line per fund column (pp12-13), proprietary Exhibit H per fund (p8). Schedule 5 (p14, receipts/disbursements by fund group vs budget, annotated 'does not match cash to cash') and Schedule 6 (p15, combined proprietary budgetary basis) not recorded to avoid double counting.
